title: "Mangrove biodiversity data analysis"
format: html

```{r}
pacman::p_load(phyloseq, biomformat, tidyverse,
               rgbif, tidyr, worrms, microeco,
               phyloseq, magrittr, aplot, metacoder)


# Load the data
df1 <- read.csv("data/taxa.csv",
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df2 <- read.csv("data/taxar.csv",
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Check similarity (optional diagnostics)
similar_columns <- intersect(names(df1),
                             names(df2))
different_columns <- setdiff(union(names(df1),
                                   names(df2)),
                             similar_columns)

cat("Shared columns:",
    paste(similar_columns, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Unique columns:",
    paste(different_columns, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Merge files by a common identifier 
merged_df <- merge(df1, df2, by = "name", all = TRUE)

# Extract and sort column names from column 3 to 113
sorted_cols <- sort(names(merged_df)[1:116])

# Apply column selection and reordering
df_eDNA <- merged_df |>
  dplyr::select(1:2, all_of(sorted_cols),
                everything()) |>
  dplyr::select(-lineage.x, -taxRank.y,
                -taxID.y,
                -lineage.y, -Max.x, -Max.y,
                -taxRank.x) |>
  mutate(name = gsub("\\[|\\]", "", name)) |>
  rename_with(~ str_remove(., "\\.cladeReads$"),
              .cols = everything()) |>
  relocate(taxID.x, .before = 2) |>
  mutate(across(3:109, ~ replace(., is.na(.)|. < 4, 0))) |>
  filter(if_any(.cols = 3:109, ~. !=0)) |>
  rename(scientific_name = name,
         otu = taxID.x) |>
  select(scientific_name, otu, everything()) |>
  drop_na(otu)
```

Loading the inventory of data collated from various online database and reviewed literature

```{r}
pacman::p_load(
  janitor,    
  lubridate,  
  tidyverse
  )

# Filter out taxa which does not confom to binomial nomenclature
pattern <-"^[A-Z][a-z]+\\s[A-Z]?[a-z]+$"

# Load inventoried data sets
gbif <- read_csv("inventory_data/gbif_.csv") |>
  select(species) |>
  drop_na() |>
  unique() |>
  rename("scienticname" = "species")

obis <- read_csv("inventory_data/obis.csv") |>
  select(scientificname) |>
  unique()

fishbase <- read_csv("inventory_data/fishbase.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(species) |>
  unique() |>
  rename("scientificname" = "species")

worm <- read_csv("inventory_data/WoRMS.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(scientific_name) |>
  unique() |>
  rename("scientificname" = "scientific_name")

lit <- read_csv("inventory_data/litsurv.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(taxon_name) |>
  drop_na() |>
  unique() |>
  rgbif::name_backbone_checklist()

lite <- lit |>
  select(species) |>
  drop_na() |> 
  rename("scientificname" = "species")

#List of data to merge
inventory <- list(
  gbif, obis, fishbase,
  worm, lite
)

#Standardize column names for all data sets
inventory <- lapply(inventory, function(df) {
  colnames(df) <- "scientificname"
  return(df)
})

#Merge all the data sets
df_inventory <- do.call(rbind, inventory) |>
  unique()

#Filter and remove non-binomial nomenclature names
df_inventory <- df_inventory |>
  filter(grepl(pattern, scientificname))

df_match <- df_eDNA |>
  select(scientific_name)

#Add a new column in A to store match results
df_match$match_results <- ifelse(df_eDNA$scientific_name
                                 %in% df_inventory$scientificname,
                                 "Expected", "Unexpected")

```

Merge all the data sets, from the microbes, and biodiversity comparizon

```{r}
# Load the necessary packages
pacman::p_load(worrms, purrr, dplyr)

#Merge the match and the df_data
df_eDNA <- full_join(df_eDNA, df_match,
                     by = "scientific_name") 


df_egbif <- name_backbone_checklist(
  df_eDNA$scientific_name)

df_egbif_clean <- df_egbif |>
  select(kingdom, phylum, class,
         order, family, genus, verbatim_name) |> 
  rename(species = verbatim_name)


df_na_class <- df_egbif |> 
  filter(is.na(class))
species_list <- df_egbif |>
  distinct() |>
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(verbatim_name) |>
  pull() 


# Break into chunks of 1000
species_chunks <- split(species_list,
                        ceiling(seq_along(species_list) / 1000))

# Break into sub-chunks of 50 names
match_worms_subchunk <- function(names_50) {
  tryCatch({
    Sys.sleep(5)
    wm_records_names(names_50)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error: ", conditionMessage(e))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Function to process one 1000-chunk
process_chunk <- function(species_chunk) {
  sub_chunks <- split(species_chunk,
                      ceiling(seq_along(species_chunk) / 50))
  map_dfr(sub_chunks, match_worms_subchunk)
}

# Process all 1000-chunks
all_matches <- map_dfr(species_chunks,
                       process_chunk)

df_worms <- all_matches |> 
  select(
    kingdom, phylum, class, order,
    family, genus, scientificname,
    isMarine, isBrackish, isFreshwater,
    isTerrestrial, isExtinct
  ) |> 
  rename(species = scientificname) |>
  mutate(across(isMarine:isExtinct, ~replace_na(., 0))) |> 
  mutate(
    Habitat = case_when(
      isMarine == 1 & isBrackish == 1 & isFreshwater == 1 & isTerrestrial == 1 ~ "Euryhaline",
      isMarine == 1 & isBrackish == 1 & isFreshwater == 1 ~ "Euryhaline",
      isMarine == 1 & isBrackish == 1 ~ "Euryhaline",
      isMarine == 1 & isFreshwater == 1 & isTerrestrial == 1 ~ "Euryhaline",
      isTerrestrial == 1 & isMarine != 1 & isBrackish != 1 ~ "Euryhaline",
      isMarine == 1 & isBrackish != 1 & isFreshwater != 1 & isTerrestrial != 1 ~ "Marine",
      isMarine != 1 & isBrackish == 1 & isFreshwater == 1 & isTerrestrial != 1 ~ "Euryhaline",
      isMarine == 1 & isBrackish != 1 & isFreshwater != 1 & isTerrestrial == 1 ~ "Euryhaline",
      isMarine != 1 & isBrackish == 1 & isFreshwater == 1 & isTerrestrial == 1 ~ "Brackish",
      isMarine == 1 & isBrackish != 1 & isFreshwater == 1 & isTerrestrial != 1 ~ "Euryhaline",
      isMarine != 1 & isBrackish == 1 & isFreshwater != 1 & isTerrestrial != 1 ~ "Brackish",
      isMarine != 1 & isBrackish == 1 & isFreshwater != 1 & isTerrestrial == 1 ~ "Brackish",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

df_feDNA <- df_egbif_clean |>
  left_join(df_worms |>
              select(species, class, Habitat),
            by = "species", suffix = c(".clean", ".worms")) |> 
  mutate(class = coalesce(class.clean, class.worms))  |> 
  select(-class.clean, -class.worms) |>
  rename(scientific_name = species)

# Merge all the datasets 
df_manuscript <- full_join(df_feDNA,
                           df_eDNA,
                           by = "scientific_name") |>
  filter(otu != 0) |>
  mutate(otu = paste0("otu_", otu)) |>
  rename(status = match_results) |>
  mutate(Habitat = if_else(kingdom =="Fungi", "Ubiquitous", Habitat)) |>
  mutate(Habitat = if_else(phylum =="Arthropoda", "Ubiquitous", Habitat)) |>
  mutate(Habitat = if_else(class =="Aves", "Terrestrial", Habitat)) |>
  mutate(Habitat = if_else(kingdom =="Plantae", "Terrestrial", Habitat)) |>
  mutate(Habitat = if_else(family == "Cyprinidae", "Brackish", Habitat)) |>
  mutate(Habitat = if_else(class == "Squamata", "Terrestrial", Habitat)) |>
  mutate(Habitat = if_else(class == "Carnivora", "Terrestrial", Habitat)) |>
  mutate(otu = make.unique(as.character(otu)))

# Microbial community
batch1 <- read_csv("data/batch_1_bacteria.csv")
batch2 <- read_csv("data/batch_2_bacteria.csv")


df_bacteria <- merge(batch1,
                      batch2, by = "name",
                      all = TRUE) |>
  rename_with(~ str_remove(., "\\.cladeReads$"),
              .cols = everything()) |>
  select(-taxRank.x, -Max.x) |>
  rename("scientific_name" = "name") |>
  rename_with(~ str_remove(., "\\.x$"),
              .cols = everything()) |>
  mutate(Habitat = "ubiquitous") |>
  relocate(Habitat, .before = 4) |> 
  mutate(status = "Expected") |>
  relocate(status, .before = 7) |>
  select(-matches("\\.y$")) |>
  rename("otu" = "taxID") |>
  rename("kingdom" = "Kingdom",
         "phylum" = "Phylum",
         "class" = "Class",
         "order" = "Order",
         "family" = "Family",
         "genus" = "Genus") |>
  mutate(otu = paste0("otu_", otu)) |>
  mutate(across(11:113, ~ replace(., is.na(.)|. < 50, 0))) |>
  filter(if_any(.cols = 11:113, ~. !=0))

# Merged data: Find shared and unique columns
shared_cols <- intersect(names(df_bacteria), 
                         names(df_manuscript))

unique_bacteria <- setdiff(names(df_bacteria),
                           shared_cols)


unique_manuscript <- setdiff(names(df_manuscript),
                             shared_cols)

# Add missing unique columns filled with 0 to each data frame
df_bacteria_extended <- df_bacteria


df_manuscript_extended <- df_manuscript |> 
  mutate(across(all_of(unique_bacteria), ~ 0))


# Now merge (inner join on the shared columns)
df_project <- bind_rows(df_bacteria_extended,
                       df_manuscript_extended) |>
  mutate(across(11:117, ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .))) |>
  mutate(Habitat = case_when(
    Habitat == "ubiquitous" ~ "Ubiquitous",
    TRUE ~ Habitat)) |>
  drop_na(otu) |>
  distinct(otu, .keep_all = TRUE)


# Assess the structure of the data
sh_habita <- df_project |>
  filter(is.na(Habitat)) |>
  select(scientific_name)

write.csv(sh_habita, "data/sh_habitat.csv")

# Import the habitat data 
sf_habitat <- read_csv("data/manual_habitat.csv") |>
  select(scientific_name, Habitat)

# First, ensure the data frames have the columns
if(!all(c("scientific_name", "Habitat") %in% colnames(df_project))) {
  stop("df_project must have columns: scientific_name, Habitat")
}
if(!all(c("scientific_name", "Habitat") %in% colnames(sf_habitat))) {
  stop("sf_habitat must have columns: scientific_name, Habitat")
}


# Perform a left join for the two data sets
df_project_updated <- df_project |> 
  left_join(sf_habitat |>
              select(scientific_name, Habitat_sf = Habitat),
            by = "scientific_name") |> 
  mutate(Habitat = if_else(is.na(Habitat),
                           Habitat_sf, Habitat)) |> 
  select(-Habitat_sf)

# Update the new data frame
df_project <- df_project_updated |>
  distinct(otu, .keep_all = TRUE)

sf_phylum <- read_csv("data/phylum.csv") |>
  select(scientific_name, phylum)

# First, ensure the data frames have the columns
if(!all(c("scientific_name", "phylum") %in% colnames(df_project))) {
  stop("df_project must have columns: scientific_name, phylum")
}
if(!all(c("scientific_name", "phylum") %in% colnames(sf_phylum))) {
  stop("sf_phylum must have columns: scientific_name, phylum")
}

df_project_phylum <- df_project |> 
  left_join(sf_phylum |>
              select(scientific_name, phylum_sf = phylum),
            by = "scientific_name") |> 
  mutate(phylum = if_else(is.na(phylum),
                           phylum_sf, phylum)) |> 
  select(-phylum_sf)

# Update the new data frame
df_project <- df_project_phylum |>
  distinct(otu, .keep_all = TRUE)

#Obtain OTU from the data frame
tax_table <- df_project |>
  select(otu, Habitat, status,
         kingdom, phylum, class, order,
         family, genus, scientific_name) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("otu")


#Obtain taxa abundance data frame 
df_abundance <- df_project |>
  select(otu, 11:117) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("otu")


df_metadata <- read.csv("data/meta.csv") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  filter(!str_ends(sample_id, "b")) |>
  mutate(sample_id =
           make.unique(as.character(sample_id))) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id")


#Transform to R6 class
otu_table <- df_abundance |>
  as.data.frame()

tax_table <- df_project |>
  select(otu, status, Habitat, kingdom,
         phylum, class, order,
         family, genus, scientific_name) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("otu") |>
  as.data.frame()

df_microeco <- microtable$new(
  otu_table = otu_table,
  tax_table = tax_table,
  sample_table = df_metadata
)    

#Transform into matrices otu and tax tables 
df_otutax <- as.matrix(tax_table)
df_abundance <- as.matrix(df_abundance)

#Transform to S4 data class
OTU <- otu_table(df_abundance,
                 taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
TAX <- tax_table(df_otutax)
sample <- sample_data(df_metadata)


df_phylo <- phyloseq(OTU,
                     TAX, sample)
```
